create.name: Karen Paolino Correia
create.bio:
Karen Paolino Correia is an intuitive, soul medium and angel teacher who works from her home in Johnston, Rhode Island, and online. Known to many as the Miracle Messenger, she has spent more than two decades helping people connect with their angels, their guides and the wisdom of their own soul. Her background includes certification as a hypnotherapist and in past-life regression, training as an Angel Therapy Practitioner, and mediumship study in the United States and at the Arthur Findlay College in England. Her own turn towards spiritual work began in the mid-1990s with what she describes as a visitation from her guardian angel during a hard period of her life.

From that training she developed two methods of her own. Soul Entrainment guides a client into deep relaxation so that they can hear their soul's answers to the questions they bring, and Soul Mediumship combines messages from loved ones who have passed with guidance from the soul. She trains others in both, has certified many Angel Messengers through an eight-week course, and offers private sessions in person and by video. Her books on angels include The Everything Guide to Angels and 101 Ways to Meet Your Angels, and she has also written a 40-day journey, What Would Love Do?, and created an oracle deck for putting questions to your soul.

courses.title: Soul Mediumship Session
courses.description: A ninety-minute session that brings together messages from loved ones in spirit and guidance from your own soul, held in person in Johnston, Rhode Island or by video call. An audio recording is included.

courses.title: Soul Entrainment Session
courses.description: A ninety-minute private session using Karen's own method: she guides you into deep relaxation so you can contact your soul and receive its answers to your questions. You leave with written notes, a soul card and a recorded meditation.

courses.title: Meet Your Guardian Angel (digital meditation)
courses.description: A downloadable guided meditation of about twenty-five minutes, led by Karen, for meeting and getting to know your guardian angel.

free_resources.title: Free Guide: How to Connect with Your Angels, with a Meet Your Guardian Angels Meditation
free_resources.description: Karen's free starter guide to working with angels, paired with a guided audio meditation, plus a page of stories and short videos from her angel readings.
